title: The Shade Administrator PLUS
description: Adds powerful admin abilities, triggers, utilities and moderation tools for Minecraft servers.
body:
# Administrator PLUS

Administrator PLUS is a vanilla datapack that gives server administrators powerful tools without requiring any mods.

## Features

### Admin Powers

- Resistance
- Fire Resistance
- Regeneration
- Water Breathing
- Dolphin's Grace
- Speed
- Jump Boost
- Strength II
- Instant Health
- Saturation
- Red particles
- Red admin name
- (Admin) suffix

### Gamemode

- Creative ON/OFF
- Spectator ON/OFF
- Fly ON/OFF

### Moderation

- Ban On Hit ON/OFF
- Kick On Hit ON/OFF
- Kill On Hit ON/OFF
- Clear Player Inventory On Hit ON/OFF

### World Controls

- Day
- Night
- Clear Weather
- Rain
- Thunder
- Reload Server

### Darkness Mode

Darkness Mode creates a storm and applies:

- Darkness
- Blindness
- Weakness
- Mining Fatigue

to nearby players within 50 blocks of the Admin.

### Utilities

- Teleport all Agents to the Admin
- Teleport to 0 0 0
- Kill Yourself
- Clear Negative Effects

## Commands

Use:

```
/tag <player> add Admin
```

Then enable triggers:

```
/trigger admin_fly_on
/trigger admin_fly_off
/trigger admin_creative_on
/trigger admin_creative_off
/trigger admin_spectator_on
/trigger admin_spectator_off
/trigger ban_on
/trigger ban_off
/trigger kick_on_hit_on
/trigger kick_on_hit_off
/trigger kill_on_hit_on
/trigger kill_on_hit_off
/trigger clear_player_inventory_on_hit_on
/trigger clear_player_inventory_on_hit_off
/trigger darkness_on
/trigger darkness_off
/trigger negative_effects_clear_on
/trigger negative_effects_clear_off
/trigger tp_agents
/trigger tp_0_0_0
/trigger kill_my_self
/trigger reload_server
/trigger day
/trigger night
/trigger weather_clear
/trigger weather_rain
/trigger weather_thunder
```

## Compatibility

Minecraft 26.1,26.1.1
Vanilla datapack
Singleplayer & Multiplayer
Required:
Entity Texture Features (ETF)
Entity Model Features (EMF)
Entity Sound Features (ESF)
